senses.gloss:
न न, a particle,
 1. Not, MBh. 3, 362.
 2. When repeated in the same sentence it implies a very strong affirmation, Absolutely, Arj. 10, 17.
 3. Lest (with a potential), Rām. 2, 63, 41.
 4. Often in the beginning of comp. words, e. g. नातिदूर, i. e. न-अति-दूर, adj. Not very distant, Hiḍ. 1, 51.
 5. ved. Like, just as, Chr. 294, 5, 4 = Rigv. i. 92, 5; 4.
 --Cf. Goth. ne, nei; A.S. ná; O.H.G. ni; Lat. ne in nonne; νη-.
